## Design

### 2026-10-09 – I learned a lot from this session!

**2.5h**

I learned a lot from this session!

I started off by downloading KiCad, setting it up and adding my libraries.

In the 30ish mins it took to download, I researched what PCBs actually are and are made of (lasagna of fiberglass and copper with holes). I also looked into a refresher on basic electrical stuff. I understand WAY better now what voltage vs amps vs power is. Basically voltage gives the electrical potential, amps is the rate charge flows at, and power is the rate at which energy is transferred. And different components on my PCB will draw different amount of amps at the same voltage to change how much energy flows through them!

then I spent an embarrassing amount of time trying to understand what net labels are. After slightly more than an hour, I had... the schematic for a single microcontroller done.

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 203222](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/sE7vZfeaqmfwXllHYiqPgB7QRPGwMqyP/1ea9feb70ebead86625514a870f6389dfcdf02a935404eb5218bcc4e92bf02f4.png)
(you can likely see my frustration from the label for this...)

But after that things went a lot more smoothly! It took about 30-45 mins to get the other 3 components done, and I learned how signal wires use electricity to transmit data (two different voltages represent 0 and 1)! And I learned that the SCL wire on the 4 and 8 pin thingies is like a CPU clock and synchronizes data transfer and the SDA is a serial data transmitter that transmits data one bit at a time!

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 203946](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/sE7vZfeaqmfwXllHYiqPgB7QRPGwMqyP/7ba6192f87f99d84f3438480210bdd41f8eac0c70cb38d0cdb339df3815aa56e.png)
extensive googling...

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 205942](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/sE7vZfeaqmfwXllHYiqPgB7QRPGwMqyP/70e72b8d25fe0e05e909d96e24575a996862bf1889bb79ba9bedd491e8d13fb0.png)
My finished schematic!

After painfully typing out every single footprint name, I finally had my components in the PCB editor.

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 210729](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/sE7vZfeaqmfwXllHYiqPgB7QRPGwMqyP/230428c920c08e508f696dfc642a15f031eabe5060f6b4e7ed5e1192bf4e8891.png)

I then spent way too long tracing out every single line on my star until I liked the way it looked.

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 212403](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/sE7vZfeaqmfwXllHYiqPgB7QRPGwMqyP/f09b0c3ea005e34606e14222cae06a926d8db3b4d402bf84e602997fc16f970e.png)

This was my stopping point for the day! This project is frustrating but super fun. I wish I knew better how everything worked but I'm sure it'll come with time. I'm excited to get back to work tomorrow but it's like nighttime and i'm tired so i'm going to sleep and dream of PCBs now.
